description: A Flutter widget implementing a map-centric home screen with Google Maps integration, location handling, ride simulation, and UI overlays for a ride-hailing app.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main widget representing the home screen with map and ride controls.

classes.name: _HomeFragmentState
classes.description: State class managing map interactions, location, ride simulation, and UI overlays.

methods.name: _getCurrentLocation
methods.description: Fetches current device location, updates map, and reverse geocodes address.

methods.name: _reverseGeocode
methods.description: Converts latitude and longitude into a human-readable address.

methods.name: _initializeMarkers
methods.description: Sets initial rider markers near user's location.

methods.name: _buildGoogleMap
methods.description: Constructs the Google Map widget with error handling fallback.

methods.name: _buildMapFallback
methods.description: Displays placeholder UI when Google Maps fails to load.

methods.name: _onCameraIdle
methods.description: Handles map camera idle event to update location and address.

methods.name: _buildBottomPanel
methods.description: Builds the bottom UI panel with location info and ride controls.

methods.name: _buildRideStatusCard
methods.description: Displays current ride status during active ride.

methods.name: _openLocationSearch
methods.description: Opens bottom sheet for destination search.

methods.name: _onDestinationSelected
methods.description: Handles destination selection, updates markers, route, and camera.

methods.name: _drawRoutePolyline
methods.description: Draws a curved red route polyline between origin and destination.

methods.name: _generateRoutePoints
methods.description: Creates intermediate points for curved route visualization.

methods.name: _fitMapToRoute
methods.description: Adjusts camera to encompass both user and destination points.

methods.name: _startRiderApproach
methods.description: Simulates rider approaching the user with periodic marker updates.

methods.name: _onRiderArrived
methods.description: Handles rider arrival, prompts user to start journey.

methods.name: _startJourney
methods.description: Simulates the journey progress with marker updates and camera movement.

methods.name: _onJourneyComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of journey, resets state, and navigates to celebration screen.
